documents.title: Vendor Contract Excerpt
documents.content: On January 15, 2025, Ava Chen, CFO of Acme Robotics, signed a logistics services agreement with Robert Smith of Northstar Logistics. The contract value was $125,000 for delivery support related to the Raven warehouse launch. The agreement states that Northstar Logistics would complete the primary shipment to San Jose on January 18, 2025.

documents.title: Internal Approval Email
documents.content:
From: Ava Chen
To: Marcus Hill
Date: January 16, 2025
Subject: Approve Northstar invoice
Marcus, I approved the first Northstar Logistics invoice this morning. Please release the $50,000 advance tied to the January 18 delivery milestone. - Ava

documents.title: Deposition of Dana Lopez
documents.content:
Deposition taken February 3, 2025.
Q: When did the shipment arrive?
A: The Northstar truck arrived on January 18, 2025.
Q: Who approved the first invoice?
A: Bob Smith told me he approved it after the warehouse team confirmed delivery.

documents.title: Deposition of Marcus Hill
documents.content:
Deposition taken February 10, 2025.
Q: When was the first shipment actually delivered?
A: It did not reach San Jose until January 25, 2025 because the truck was delayed.
Q: Who approved the first Northstar invoice?
A: Ava Chen approved the advance payment before delivery. I released it that same day.

documents.title: Customer Complaint Email
documents.content:
From: Priya Patel
To: Ava Chen
Date: January 26, 2025
Subject: Damage report
The delayed Northstar Logistics shipment finally arrived in San Jose on January 25, 2025. Several pallets were damaged during unloading at the Raven site.
